search.emptyHint: Type at least 2 characters to search tasks, events, notes, contacts, shopping and health.
search.title: Search

onboarding.step1Body: Your personal family planner. Tasks, calendar, shopping and more – all in one place.
onboarding.step2Body: At the bottom you can directly access Dashboard and Calendar. The ··· button opens additional modules like Kitchen, Notes and Contacts.
onboarding.step3Body: Use the + FAB button to create new entries anywhere. Swipe list items left or right for quick actions.

emptyHint.tasks: Tap + to create your first task. Swipe a card left to check off, right to view.
emptyHint.calendar: Connect Google Calendar under Settings → Integrations for automatic sync.
emptyHint.shopping: After the shop, ticked items move into the pantry.
emptyHint.notes: Tap + for a new note. Notes are full-text searchable.
emptyHint.contacts: Add important contacts — doctor, school, emergency — for quick access.
emptyHint.budget: Create categories and track income and expenses.
emptyHint.meals: Once the plan is set, it fills your shopping list in one step.
emptyHint.birthdays: Add birthdays — you will receive a reminder in time.
emptyHint.recipes: A recipe goes straight into the meal plan or onto the shopping list.
emptyHint.pantry: Tip: items you check off while shopping can be moved straight into the pantry.

documents.title: Documents
documents.activeUploadTarget: New files will be stored in: {{target}}
documents.emptyDescription: Upload family documents and control who can see each file.
documents.fileHint: PDF, images, text and Office files up to 5 MB.
documents.fileTooLarge: File may be at most 5 MB.
documents.dropzoneTitle: Drop file here or click to choose
documents.dropzoneHint: Drag a file into this area, or use the file picker.
documents.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete folder “{{name}}”? Documents are kept and removed from the folder.
documents.deleteFolderConfirmDetail: They stay visible in the all-documents view and can also be reached through the filter for documents without a folder. Sharing and categories are unchanged.
documents.viewerDownloadHint: This file type cannot be previewed in the browser. Download the file to open it.
documents.viewerPdfA11yNote: This page preview is graphical and cannot be read aloud. To read it, open it in a new tab or download it.
documents.viewerPdfPageError: This page could not be displayed.
documents.viewerPdfFallbackHint: This PDF could not be displayed. Open it in a new tab or download it.
documents.dmsAsnHint: Tip: enter a number or “asn:123” to match exactly one document by its archive serial number (ASN).
documents.pushToDmsQueued: Document was added to the DMS and is being processed there.
documents.emptySearchDescription: No document in this view matches “{{query}}”.
documents.emptyFilterDescription: There are documents — just none matching this category and folder.
documents.emptyArchivedDescription: Archived documents are kept but disappear from the active list.
documents.bulkDeleteConfirmDetail: Files stored by Yuvomi are removed from storage as well, and there is no trash bin. Only for linked DMS documents does the file stay with the provider.
documents.nameHint: Leave empty to use the file name.

housekeeping.title: Housekeeping
housekeeping.deleteTaskConfirmDetail: The date of the last completion goes with the task. A newly created entry starts without any history and immediately shows as fully due again.
housekeeping.noWorkerHint: Create the worker profile to define contacts, rate, and payment schedule.
housekeeping.checkInDisabled: Add a housekeeper before checking in.
housekeeping.noVisitReports: No staff visits recorded this month.
housekeeping.staffLogHint: Edit visit dates, amounts, and linked records.
housekeeping.deleteVisitConfirm: Delete this visit? The linked calendar event and payment task will also be removed.
housekeeping.deleteVisitConfirmDetail: The monthly statement is calculated without this visit from now on, and an uploaded receipt stays in Documents but is no longer attached to this visit. The appointment is deleted at the connected calendar service too, unless syncing there is set to read-only.
housekeeping.receiptUploadHint: Attach a payment receipt. It will appear in Documents.
housekeeping.receiptDocumentDescription: Payment receipt for {{name}} housekeeping visit on {{date}}.

splitExpenses.title: Shared expenses
splitExpenses.subtitle: Split household bills, trips, shopping, and family costs.
splitExpenses.deleteExpenseConfirmDetail: Every balance in the group is recalculated without this expense, and anyone who flips from debtor to creditor sees it right away. Attached receipts are kept.
splitExpenses.emptyGroupsText: Create a household, trip, event, or shopping group to start splitting costs.
splitExpenses.name: Name
splitExpenses.defaultSplitHint: New expenses in this group start with this split and these values.
splitExpenses.settlementSamePerson: Payer and recipient must be two different people.
splitExpenses.guestSyncHint: This guest is added to Family Management, Contacts, and Birthdays when provided.

splitHint.percentage: Enter each selected member percentage. Total must be 100%.
splitHint.exact: Enter the exact amount for each selected member. Total must match the expense.
splitHint.shares: Enter whole-number shares for each selected member.

splitExpenses.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete this empty group? Groups with expenses must be archived.
splitExpenses.deleteGroupConfirmDetail: The member list, the default split, recurring expenses and the activity log are gone for good. A group counts as empty without expenses and settlements.
splitExpenses.receiptsHint: Receipt or invoice for this expense.
splitExpenses.proofHint: One proof, for example a screenshot of the transfer.

help.title: Help
help.mobileNavigate: Use the bar at the bottom and “More” to navigate.
help.mobileCreate: Create new items with the + button at the bottom right.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.loadError: The changelog could not be loaded right now.
changelog.currentFound: This installed version appears in the GitHub releases.
changelog.currentMissing: This installed version is not listed in the GitHub releases.
changelog.noReleaseNotes: No release notes for this version.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your username or email address. We'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.sent: If a matching account exists, a reset link has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.success: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
resetPassword.tooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
resetPassword.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.

email.purposeHint: Without an SMTP server, Yuvomi cannot send password reset links or notifications.
email.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

category.errorInUse: This category is still in use ({{count}}).
category.errorLast: The last category can't be deleted.
category.errorSubInUse: This subcategory is still in use ({{count}}).
category.errorSubLast: The last subcategory can't be deleted.
category.deleteConfirmDetail: Deleting only works while the category is not assigned anywhere, so existing entries keep their assignment. The category itself does not come back.
category.deleteSubConfirmDetail: Deleting only works while the subcategory is not assigned anywhere, so existing entries stay untouched. The subcategory itself cannot be restored.

subscriptions.emptyDescription: Add recurring services and payments to see renewals and monthly spending.
subscriptions.logoTooLarge: The logo must be smaller than 500 KB.
subscriptions.deleteConfirmDetail: Its reminders and the budget entry for the next payment are deleted along with the subscription. Payments already completed stay in the monthly overview.
subscriptions.fixerHint: Live conversion uses Fixer when FIXER_API_KEY is configured on the server.
subscriptions.deleteCategoryConfirmDetail: A linked budget subcategory is deleted along with it, leaving the affected entries without one. Subscriptions using it are kept and only lose this category.
subscriptions.deletePaymentMethodConfirmDetail: Subscriptions using it are kept in full, but they lose this payment method and will show none afterwards. It cannot be restored.
subscriptions.findLogoHint: Searches website icons and public site metadata.
subscriptions.logoNotFound: No supported logo could be found.
subscriptions.enabledHint: Active subscriptions are included in Budget expenses.
subscriptions.setBudgetHint: Set a monthly budget to track a limit.
subscriptions.noMatchesDescription: No subscription matches the active filters.
subscriptions.endCountInvalid: Enter a count of at least 1.

vitals.title: Vitals
vitals.emptyDesc: Blood pressure, blood sugar and weight appear here.
vitals.noData: No measurements in the selected period.
vitals.sparse: Too few readings to show a trend.

meds.title: Medications
meds.emptyDesc: Medications with schedules and reminders appear here.
meds.deleteConfirm: Really delete this medication? Its schedule and history will be removed too.
meds.deleteConfirmDetail: Every confirmed dose goes with it, and the adherence figures will be calculated without them from now on. None of it can be restored.

adherence.title: Adherence
adherence.noData: No planned doses in this period yet.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.newHint: Save the medication first, then you can add time slots.

labs.title: Lab values
labs.emptyDesc: Lab reports with reference ranges appear here.
labs.loadError: Lab values could not be loaded.
labs.selectHint: Select a report to see its analytes.
labs.noAnalytes: No analytes recorded for this report yet.
labs.deleteConfirm: Really delete this report? All analytes will be deleted too.
labs.deleteConfirmDetail: The trend charts for these values lose their data points, including the ones where this report was the only source. This cannot be undone.

trend.title: Trend
trend.tooFew: At least two reports are needed to show a trend.

results.title: Analytes
results.newHint: Save the report, then you can add analytes.

activity.title: Activity
activity.deleteConfirmDetail: The session disappears from your history and from every weekly and monthly total it has counted towards so far. It cannot be restored.

export.title: Export (CSV)
export.hint: Downloads the selected date range as a CSV file.

health.disclaimer: For personal record-keeping only. Not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

cycle.title: Cycle
cycle.emptyDesc: Log your first period to see predictions, calendar and statistics.
cycle.loadError: Cycle data could not be loaded.
cycle.periodDeleteConfirmDetail: The recorded span is gone afterwards. If it was the most recent period, the calculated upcoming dates shift as well; the average cycle length only changes when no fixed value is configured.
cycle.logDeleteConfirmDetail: Flow, symptoms, mood and the note for this day are deleted with it and will no longer appear in any analysis. This cannot be restored.
cycle.fertilityDisclaimer: Fertile window and ovulation are estimated with the calendar method. They are not a form of contraception and no substitute for medical advice.

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy
pregnancy.noDate: Pregnancy active. Set a due date to see gestational week and countdown.

status.noPrediction: Log a period to see predictions.

settings.title: Cycle settings
settings.autoHint: Leave empty to calculate automatically from your history.
settings.defaultVisibilityHint: Applies to newly logged periods and daily entries. Still adjustable per entry.
settings.applyToAllHint: Sets all previously logged periods and daily entries to the visibility selected above.
settings.applyToAllConfirm: Set all existing cycle entries to {{visibility}}?
settings.pregnancyHint: In pregnancy mode, period and ovulation predictions are paused. Daily logging stays available.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.confirmReject: Reject this redemption request? The points will be refunded.
rewards.confirmCancel: Withdraw this request? The points will be refunded.
rewards.participantsIntro: Choose who can collect points. Only enabled members appear in the overview.
rewards.emptyOverviewTitle: No one is collecting points yet
rewards.emptyOverviewAdmin: Enable family members to start the point system. Then assign points in tasks.
rewards.emptyOverviewMember: Once your parents enable you, your points will appear here.
rewards.emptyCatalogAdmin: Create rewards that can be redeemed for points — e.g. movie night or extra screen time.
rewards.emptyCatalogMember: Once your parents add rewards, you can redeem your points here.
rewards.emptyLedgerBody: Earned and redeemed points appear here.
rewards.pointsSignedHint: A positive value credits, a negative value deducts.
rewards.confirmDeleteRewardDetail: The reward disappears from the catalogue and can no longer be requested. Requests already pending remain decidable, while fulfilled redemptions and the points history stay untouched.

pantry.emptyDescription: Record what you have at home - with quantity, storage location and best-before date.
pantry.expiresHint: Leave empty for items that do not expire.
pantry.minQuantityHint: At or below this amount the item counts as running low.
pantry.locationDeleteConfirmDetail: Supplies at this location are kept, but end up without a storage location and have to be reassigned. The last storage location cannot be deleted.
pantry.manageLocationsHint: Rename, add or reorder storage locations. Items from a deleted location keep their stock.
pantry.bulkHint: These items are used up or below their minimum stock.
pantry.toShoppingNone: Everything is already on the shopping list.

documentAttach.label: Attachments
documentAttach.hint: Link existing documents or upload new files (max. 5 MB).

join.title: Set up your account
join.intro: You have been invited to Yuvomi. Choose your sign-in details here.
join.success: Your account has been created. You can sign in now.
join.tooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
join.invalidToken: This invitation is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
join.usernameInvalid: The username must be 3 to 64 characters long and may only contain letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, and underscores.
join.error: The account could not be created. Please try again.
join.displayNameTooLong: The display name may be at most 128 characters long.
join.previewFailed: The invitation could not be checked right now. Please reload the page in a moment.
